newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Danubius boosts stake in Helia Hotel.
newsitem.headline: Danubius boosts stake in Helia Hotel.

text.p: Hungarian hotel chain Danubius Hotels Rt said it boosted its stake in Helia Hotel to 99.94 percent, exercising its option rights set in a deal last year.

"Danubius Hotels Rt...today transferred the 563 million forints purchase price to the Budapest City Council as set in an option deal signed on February 2, 1996, for its 26.57 percent stake in Helia Hotel Rt," Danubius said in a statement.
In early 1996 Danubius boosted its stake to 73.34 percent by acquiring a 59.82 percent stake in Magyar-Finn Szalloda Rt hotel company, which owned Thermal Helia Hotel.
At that time Danubius also signed a declaration of intent to buy the Budapest Council's 26.57 percent stake.
